neet_che_u06_t05_1.working: Since ΔG° = −RT ln K, a positive ΔG° gives ln K < 0, so K < 1 and reactants predominate at equilibrium.

neet_che_u06_t05_3.working: ΔG = RT ln(Q/K). Here Q (10) > K (4.0), so ΔG > 0 and the net reaction runs in reverse until Q = K.

neet_che_u06_t05_4.working: A: ΔG° < 0 gives K > 1 (III). B: ΔG° = 0 gives K = 1 (I). C: ΔG = 0 means equilibrium, Q = K (II). D: ΔG > 0 means the reverse reaction is spontaneous (IV).

neet_che_u06_t05_5.working: A is true. B is false: at equilibrium ΔG = 0, not ΔG°. C is true: ΔG° depends on T, so K changes with T. D is true: K = 1 gives ΔG° = 0. E is false: if Q < K, the forward reaction proceeds even when ΔG° > 0. Correct set is A, C, D.
